headline: Fronts Flare at Fishermans Row Lykos Isle
war_summary: Since the 12:11 edition the western fringe has intensified. Fishermans Row recorded seven ownership changes in the past two hours, the latest at 14:10 Z, pushing its day‑total to thirty flips. Lykos Isle, quiet in the earlier report, now logs three captures in the last two hours and twelve in the past day, most recent at 14:53 Z. Weathered Expanse added four flips in the last two hours, the newest at 15:10 Z, though its casualty surge has begun to cool. Farranac Coast and Tempest Island have shown no new flips since 04:10 Z and 08:25 Z respectively, yet both retain high 24‑hour counts (15 and 10). Dead Lands continues a steady tempo with five events yesterday, last at 23:25 Z. Casualty streams sharpen on several fronts: Loch Mor, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow show accelerating losses for both sides; Farranac Coast, Kings Cage and Stlican Shelf also accelerate; Clahstra eases but remains above 500 per hour each faction. The strategic picture still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
